A link refers to the AWS Marketplace product page for **Cohere Rerank v4.0 Pro**.[1]

## Product Overview  
Cohere Rerank v4.0 Pro enhances search systems by reordering documents based on semantic relevance to user queries. It offers a "fast" mode for quick reranking performance, making it suitable for real-time applications. Published on December 4, 2025, this listing is accessible via the AWS Console for deployment.[1]

## Key Features  
- Improves search accuracy through semantic similarity scoring.  
- Supports fast processing for production-scale use.[1]
- Available for purchase and integration directly in AWS environments.[3]
